description: blueteam-fabric's GZCoord integration: the operator repository's roles (fabric-coordinator, and language-culture for the locales) are on the fleet's coordination channel, the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project blueteam-fabric; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-11-12, at registration (j766).
